title: Sleep — CPAP therapy (SleepHQ)
description: CPAP therapy from SleepHQ. Nightly samples sit at 12:00 UTC, so every query uses last_over_time over a >24h window.

panels.title: AHI — last full night
panels.description: Most recent night with >= 1h of use, so a partial or not-yet-fully-uploaded session (e.g. an 18-minute record) is skipped in favour of the last real night. Nightly samples sit at 12:00 UTC; the inner last_over_time holds each night's value so the daily subquery step lands on it.

panels.title: Usage — last full night
panels.description: Most recent night with >= 1h of use, so a partial or not-yet-fully-uploaded session (e.g. an 18-minute record) is skipped in favour of the last real night. Nightly samples sit at 12:00 UTC; the inner last_over_time holds each night's value so the daily subquery step lands on it.

panels.title: Nights >= 4h (30d)
panels.description: Percent of the last 30 nights with >= 4h machine-on time. last_over_time must be INSIDE the subquery: samples sit at 12:00 UTC and a bare [30d:1d] subquery steps straight past them, yielding no data.

panels.title: AHI — events per hour
panels.description: Apnea-Hypopnea Index. Clinical bands: <5 normal, 5-15 mild, 15-30 moderate, >30 severe. Dashed lines mark the bands.

panels.title: AHI by event type
panels.description: Stacked components of total AHI. all_apnea and unidentified_apnea are 0 across the full history and are omitted.

panels.title: Usage
panels.description: Machine-on time per calendar date -- NOT verified as time asleep. See sleephq-exporter/README.md.

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: cmH2O. 'upper' is the 95th percentile, not the max.

panels.title: Leak rate
panels.description: Mask leak. Sustained high 95th percentile means a fit problem.

panels.title: AHI — nightly vs 30-night average
panels.description: Nightly AHI is noisy at this range (0-1.5). The 30-night rolling average is the actual trend.

panels.title: Machine settings
panels.description: Each device setting as its own row; a band boundary is a change. Pressures are cmH2O, EPR/humidity/ramp are level indices. Most are constant over this range -- EPR dropped 3 -> 2 on 2026-07-14. The value is printed in each band.

panels.title: EPAP
panels.description: Exhale pressure, cmH2O. Tracks pressure_min minus the EPR level -- an EPR change moves this floor directly.

panels.title: Flow limitation
panels.description: Upper-airway restriction. Median is 0 on effectively every night, so average and 95th percentile are the informative stats.

panels.title: SleepHQ scores
panels.description: SleepHQ's own 0-100 grades. All three sit at ~100, so the axis starts at 85 -- the dips are the only signal here.

panels.title: AHI by day of week
panels.description: Mean AHI per weekday over the selected range.

panels.title: Usage by day of week
panels.description: Mean machine-on hours per weekday over the selected range.

panels.title: AHI distribution
panels.description: How nightly AHI is distributed, rather than how it moves. Bucket width 0.1 events/hour.

panels.title: O2 Ring (not currently syncing -- last upload 2024)
